summary: Backend + frontend payment regression completed against public preview URL. Stripe package/session/status APIs passed, profile renders purchasable upgrade and buy flow redirects to Stripe checkout, and legacy premium activation still works.
action_items: Optional: align backend/frontend env naming guidance (EXPO_BACKEND_URL vs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) to avoid future deployment drift.
Optional: provide /app/memory/test_credentials.md so future auth regression runs can reuse stable accounts instead of creating throwaway users.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses STRIPE_API_KEY = os.environ.get('STRIPE_API_KEY', '') with an empty default; this weakens fail-fast env policy.
Profile copy has typo 'Purchaseable Upgrades' (should be 'Purchasable Upgrades').
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users via auth register during pytest and UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL was reachable. Early UI attempts were flaky due navigation/timing, but final mobile run confirmed package rendering and Stripe redirect. No APIs were mocked.
rca_of_issue: No blocking defects found in requested scope. Earlier UI failures were non-deterministic timing/viewport interaction artifacts during automation and were resolved with stable path + wait.
